description.intro: The Hummel Celta de Vigo Core 2.0 training pants are part of the official RC Celta training collection for the 2026-2027 season. Designed to offer comfort, freedom of movement and a sporty fit, it is the ideal garment to prepare for each session with the same style as the team.
key_benefits: Official RC Celta design: Training pants for the 2026 2027 season.
Comodidad en movimiento: Corte deportivo que favorece la movilidad.
Light, breathable fabric: Helps maintain comfort even during the most intense sessions.
Secure fit: Elastic waist with adjustable drawstring for personalized support.
